newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey gives mandate for Sept Eurodollar issue.
newsitem.headline: Turkey gives mandate for Sept Eurodollar issue.

text.p: Turkey has mandated Morgan Stanley International Limited and Salomon Brothers to lead its Eurodollar issue, expected to be set in September, the treasury said in a statement.
"The issue might take place in September," it said.
The treasury did not give any detail on the size and maturity of the issue. Banking sources expect the size to be at around $400-500 million with a maturity around 10 years.
Turkey has raised around $1.4 billion in the international capital markets so far this year. It last issued five-year Eurobonds worth one billion marks in early June.
The republic also realised a seven-year 500 million mark issue in January, a five-year 300 billion Italian lire in February and a five-year $400 million issue in May.
"Turkey will continue to borrow in line with its target of extending maturity and lowering borrowing costs," the treasury said.
